title: Living worlds
summary: The worlds come alive. The land has mountain chains, valleys, canyons and abysses, and you climb it - up and along cliffs and walls, each with its own move - and slide down it. Caves and dungeons are part of the ground, walked into from the land. Sunrise and sunset paint the sky gold and rose; nights and the underground have a soft light, and your lamp lights the ground. Weather moves over each world: three cloud layers, rain, storms with lightning, snow and ash, the ground wet, muddy or snowed on, with the weather, temperature and radioactivity on the HUD; the sun's rays break through clouds and trees. The compass shows latitude and longitude on a world and yaw and pitch in space, and the ground hides markers. The green worlds grow Greek trees of real branches and leaves among far more grass and flowers, over a Greek ground. A new dragonfly, aeromanta and red fox. Your automaton's rifle folds onto its hip, thrusters fire from its soles, and a shield guards it. Roads join more towns, with caravans and travellers attacked by raiders and beasts, and everything that dies leaves loot.

steps.title: Mountains, valleys, canyons - and climbing them
steps.text: Each world's land has long mountain chains (snow on the high peaks where it's cold), valleys winding through the high ground and narrow canyons; the sea worlds have abysses and canyons on their floor. Ground too steep to walk you climb, facing it - up, and sideways along it, each with its own move; head down it and you slide on your feet, facing down, steering across. The same on a building's walls: past its windows (not in through them), onto its roof; the storeys' walls now meet with no slit between floors.

steps.title: Caves and dungeons in the ground
steps.text: Caves are carved into the ground itself - passages into a hillside under an arch of boulders, and into the walls of the sea worlds' abysses, flooded - with chambers, their life and a chest in the deepest. Dungeons too: a stone gateway with horns over a passage going down to rooms and corridors cut in the rock, their torches, skeleton warriors and a demon. No loading, no other place: walk in from the land. Down there the sky isn't drawn, your shots hit the rock and the sights stay past you.

steps.title: Light: sunsets, nights, underground
steps.text: When the sun rises or sets the sky turns gold and orange towards it and rose opposite, a glow round the sun, the clouds lit from below, the light warm. By night and underground there is a soft ambient light - cool under the stars, warm in caves and dungeons - and your shoulder lamp now lights the ground (it lit nothing: the ground's shader took every light for the sun).

steps.title: Weather: local, moving, in layers
steps.text: Each world with air has weather systems over their own parts of it, drifting round the world, building, raining - snow where it's cold, ash on the volcanic worlds - and dying away. Three cloud layers at their own speeds and shapes, thick and dark under a cell, a storm's black. Rain slants in the wind, snow tumbles all round you, lightning strikes with its thunder after; the ground gets wet and muddy, puddles form, snow lies. The HUD shows the weather, temperature and radioactivity.

steps.title: Sun rays, the compass, markers
steps.text: By day in a world's air the sun's light breaks through the gaps in the clouds and the trees in shafts. On a world the compass shows your latitude and longitude, as the planet map does; in space it has no north - its yaw and pitch instead. The ground now hides the markers behind it: a hill, or the world's curve.

steps.title: Greek trees, grass and ground
steps.text: The green worlds grow Greece: olives and cypresses everywhere, and four of stone pine, Aleppo pine, plane, holm oak, carob, fig, fir and palm, with maquis and thyme, four grasses and meadow flowers. Every tree is built of real branches; up close its twigs carry single leaves. Woods, groves, clearings and meadows; saplings to old giants. Close up the ground shows terra rossa, limestone, stones and dry golden grass.

steps.title: New creatures: dragonfly, aeromanta, fox
steps.text: Three animals made again in detail: a dragonfly with veined wings beating in pairs, a sky manta gliding on long slow wingbeats, and a red fox - its trot, its run, its sniffing and turning - each one shared mesh, moved in its shader.

diagram.text: warmed at the title: no hitch when first seen

steps.title: The automaton: folding rifle, boot thrusters, shield
steps.text: The jet pack is gone: thrusters in the soles of your automaton's feet fire when you hold Space - a flame under each foot. The rifle folds into a short block and rides in a holster on the right hip; drawing it unfolds it into your hands. A shield wraps you like a ship's: it takes the blows first, flickers where it's hit and comes back a few seconds after the last.

diagram.text: your edited automaton gets the new moves

steps.title: Roads, caravans and loot
steps.text: Worlds have more towns - up to three cities and villages round them - joined by roads found over the land the easy way round its mountains. Caravans of traders, guards and pack donkeys carry what one town makes to one that needs it; couriers, pilgrims and patrols travel too. Raiders and beasts attack them; guards fight back, a caravan can be wiped out and its goods left in the road. Whatever dies leaves a pouch to loot.

Their dead walk: **skeleton warriors** with bronze helmets, round shields and short swords come for you in the rooms; deeper in, **demons** hurl fire from afar and claw up close; in the deepest room a **demon lord** guards a **chest** (click it to open it: drachmas). The walls stop your bolts and theirs. Downed below, your ship's drones carry you out.
+- **Caves** - every rocky world's ground has its **caves**: passages carved into a hillside (an arch of boulders round the opening) and, on the sea worlds, into the wall of each **abyss** - flooded, swum. Walk (or swim) straight in: no loading, the same world - the passage winds down into the hill, branches, and opens into **chambers**; your lamp comes on, the rock overhead holds you down (no jumping or jetting through it). Their dead wake as you come near: **skeleton warriors** with bronze helmets, round shields and short swords; **demons** that hurl fire from afar and claw up close; in the deepest chamber a **demon lord** guards a bronze **chest** (click it to open it: drachmas, once).
+- **Dungeons** - most rocky worlds have one or two (a stone gateway with horns of consecration over a passage going down) - built into the ground itself like the caves: walk down the passage from the gateway and through its doorway, no loading. Below: an old labyrinth's dressed stone and red pillars, lit by torches; its dead as a cave's (the sun's gone, the compass too - you're under the ground), its demon lord and chest in the deepest room. The walls stop your bolts and theirs. Downed below, your ship's drones carry you out.

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the folding rifle
+# A skin's rifle may collapse for its holster (GUN_FOLD, from the skin: build.skin_module): pieces of it on bones
+# of their own under the gun bone, each at its hinge ("pivot", the gun bone's axes: x side, y muzzle, z top),
+# folded by the pose's "fold" (0 the whole rifle .. 1 collapsed) - each in its own share of it ("span": from, to;
+# the barrel first as it folds, the stock last - unfolding the other way): turned "angle" degrees about "axis"
+# and slid by "slide" (the gun's axes). "parent": a piece riding on another (the barrel in the fore-end).
+GUN_FOLD = {}
+
+
+def fold_k(f, span):
+    a, b = span
+    t = max(0.0, min(1.0, (f - a) / (b - a)))
+    return t * t * (3 - 2 * t)
+
+
+def _fold_pieces(mats, f):
+    for name, spec in GUN_FOLD.items():
+        t = fold_k(f, spec["span"])
+        par = spec.get("parent", "gun")
+        pp = GUN_FOLD[par]["pivot"] if par != "gun" else (0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
+        piv = Vector(spec["pivot"]) - Vector(pp)
+        loc = Matrix.Translation(piv + Vector(spec.get("slide", (0, 0, 0))) * t)
+        if spec.get("angle"):

files.explanation: New: the aeromanta's own model, a sky manta ray whose disc is its wings, built once on a worker as one shared single-surface mesh; its shader draws the skin and rolls waves out along the wings.

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,172 @@ 
+class_name CosmosAeromanta
+extends RefCounted
+## The aeromanta (CosmosFauna "aeromanta", kind "model": "aeromanta") - a manta
+## ray of the sky, its own model, not the generic flyer: one shared mesh of one
+## surface (one draw call), made on a worker like the dragonfly's:
+##  - the disc: a broad diamond that IS the wings - a closed loft across the span,
+##    each station an airfoil (blunt rounded leading edge, thick over the body,
+##    thinning to the falcate tips; the back domed, the belly flatter), its
+##    leading edges curved and swept back, its trailing edge concave;
+##  - the cephalic fins (two scrolled lobes forward of the wide mouth), eyes at the
+##    head's sides, a small dorsal fin, the pelvic fins either side of the tail's
+##    root, the long thin whip tail (UV2.x: how far along it, 0 off it).
+## COLOR: g the eyes, b the cephalic and pelvic fins. The skin, its gill slits, the
+## mouth, the back's pale shoulder marks and the belly's spots are the shader's
+## (aeromanta.gdshader), which also moves it: waves travelling from the body out
+## to the tips (`phase`, `wave`), the tail rippling and trailing a turn (`bend`).
+## Unit space: CosmosCreature scales it by the species' size; forward is -z.
+
+const SHADER := preload("res://shaders/world/aeromanta.gdshader")
+const SPAN := 1.45          # (half the wingspan)
+const TAIL := 1.9           # (the whip tail's length)
+
+static var _mesh: ArrayMesh
+static var _task := -1
+static var _built: Builder
+## What the last build made (the tests read it).
+static var made := {}
+
+
+static func start() -> void:
+	if _mesh != null or _task >= 0:
+		return
+	_built = Builder.new()
+	_task = WorkerThreadPool.add_task(_built.run, false, "aeromanta mesh")
+
+
+static func is_ready() -> bool:
+	return _mesh != null or (_task >= 0 and WorkerThreadPool.is_task_completed(_task))
+
+
+static func mesh() -> ArrayMesh:
+	if _mesh == null:
+		start()
+		WorkerThreadPool.wait_for_task_completion(_task)
+		_task = -1
+		var m := ArrayMesh.new()
+		m.add_surface_from_arrays(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES, _built.body.arrays())
+		m.custom_aabb = AABB(Vector3(-SPAN - 0.2, -0.6, -1.0), Vector3(SPAN * 2.0 + 0.4, 1.2, TAIL + 1.8))   # (the waves and the tail inside)
+		made = {"stations": _built.stations, "tail_rings": _built.tail_rings, "fins": _built.fins, "eyes": _built.eyes, "build_ms": _built.ms}
+		_built = null
+		_mesh = m
+	return _mesh
+
+
+## Its own material (its hit flash, its waves).
+static func material(c1: Color, c2: Color) -> ShaderMaterial:
+	var m := ShaderMaterial.new()
+	m.shader = SHADER
+	m.set_shader_parameter("c1", c1)
+	m.set_shader_parameter("c2", c2)
+	m.set_shader_parameter("span", SPAN)
+	m.set_shader_parameter("noise_tex", Cosmos.noise_ready())
+	return m
+
+
+## The disc's leading and trailing edges at `a` (0 the middle .. 1 the tip), z.
+static func edges(a: float) -> Vector2:
+	var lead := -0.56 + 0.86 * pow(a, 1.55) - 0.07 * sin(PI * pow(a, 0.7))
+	var trail := lerpf(0.5, 0.3, a) - 0.2 * sin(PI * pow(a, 0.75)) * (1.0 - 0.2 * a)
+	if a < 0.1:   # (the wide mouth: the head's front squared off)
+		lead = lerpf(-0.53, lead, smoothstep(0.0, 0.1, a))
+	return Vector2(lead, maxf(trail, lead + 0.004))
+
+
+## The disc's half thickness at `a`: the body's dome in the middle, the wings thin.
+static func thick(a: float) -> float:
+	return 0.022 * (1.0 - a) * (1.0 - a * 0.6) + 0.12 * exp(-pow(a / 0.2, 2.0))
+
+
+class Builder extends CosmosDragonfly.Builder:
+	var stations := 0
+	var tail_rings := 0
+	var fins := 0
+	var eyes := 0
+
+	func run() -> void:
+		var t0 := Time.get_ticks_usec()
+		_disc()
+		_head()
+		_fins()
+		_tail()
+		ms = (Time.get_ticks_usec() - t0) / 1000.0
+
+	## The disc: rings across the span (x), each a closed airfoil in y-z.
+	func _disc() -> void:
+		var p := body
+		var n := 48
+		var sides := 32
+		var base := p.v.size()
+		var plain := Color(0, 0, 0)
+		for i in n + 1:
+			var u := float(i) / n * 2.0 - 1.0
+			u = signf(u) * pow(absf(u), 1.35)   # (stations crowded at the body)
+			var a := absf(u)
+			var e := CosmosAeromanta.edges(a)
+			var h := CosmosAeromanta.thick(a)
+			var droop := -0.05 * a * a   # (the wings' tips a little down at rest)
+			for j in sides + 1:
+				var th := TAU * j / sides
+				var c := (1.0 - cos(th)) * 0.5
+				var z := lerpf(e.x, e.y, c)
+				var s := sin(th)
+				var prof := (1.0 - 0.55 * c) * (1.0 + 0.4 * (1.0 - c) * exp(-pow(a / 0.12, 2.0)))   # (thickest forward; the head's front rounded)
+				var y := s * h * prof * (1.0 if s > 0.0 else 0.5) + droop
+				p.add(Vector3(u * CosmosAeromanta.SPAN, y, z), plain, Vector2(u, c), Vector2.ZERO)
+			stations += 1
+		for i in n:
+			for j in sides:
+				var a := base + i * (sides + 1) + j
+				var b := a + sides + 1
+				p.tri(a, a + 1, b)
+				p.tri(a + 1, b + 1, b)
+
+	func _head() -> void:
+		var eye := Color(0, 1, 0)
+		# Eyes at the head's sides, just behind the cephalic fins.
+		for side in [-1.0, 1.0]:
+			blob(Vector3(side * 0.2, 0.028, -0.53), Vector3(0.028, 0.026, 0.032), Vector3.BACK, eye, 8, 12, 0.0, Vector2(0, 0))
+			eyes += 1
+
+	func _fins() -> void:
+		var fin := Color(0, 0, 1)
+		var z0 := Vector2(0, 0)
+		for side in [-1.0, 1.0]:
+			# The cephalic fins: flat lobes forward of the mouth, scrolled inward.
+			var b := Vector3(side * 0.13, 0.0, -0.5)
+			loft([b, b + Vector3(side * 0.012, -0.004, -0.06), b + Vector3(side * 0.004, -0.012, -0.13), b + Vector3(-side * 0.012, -0.02, -0.19), b + Vector3(-side * 0.022, -0.022, -0.215)],
+				[Vector2(0.014, 0.04), Vector2(0.012, 0.042), Vector2(0.01, 0.036), Vector2(0.008, 0.024), Vector2(0.002, 0.004)],
+				[fin, fin, fin, fin, fin], [z0, z0, z0, z0, z0], 10)
+			# The pelvic fins: small flaps either side of the tail's root.
+			var q := Vector3(side * 0.06, -0.025, 0.36)
+			loft([q, q + Vector3(side * 0.03, -0.004, 0.06), q + Vector3(side * 0.035, -0.006, 0.13)],
+				[Vector2(0.035, 0.012), Vector2(0.03, 0.009), Vector2(0.004, 0.002)], [fin, fin, fin], [z0, z0, z0], 8)
+			fins += 2
+		# A small dorsal fin on the back, before the tail.
+		var d := Vector3(0, 0.05, 0.4)
+		loft([d, d + Vector3(0, 0.035, 0.035), d + Vector3(0, 0.05, 0.08)],
+			[Vector2(0.006, 0.03), Vector2(0.004, 0.018), Vector2(0.001, 0.002)], [fin, fin, fin], [z0, z0, z0], 8)
+		fins += 1
+
+	## The whip tail: long and thin, UV2.x along it (the shader ripples it).
+	func _tail() -> void:
+		var pts := []
+		var rad := []
+		var cols := []
+		var uvs := []
+		var n := 28
+		var start := Vector3(0, 0.0, 0.3)
+		for i in n + 1:
+			var t := float(i) / n
+			pts.append(start + Vector3(0, 0.03 * t, t * CosmosAeromanta.TAIL))
+			var r := lerpf(0.04, 0.003, pow(t, 0.55))
+			rad.append(Vector2(r, r * 0.9))
+			cols.append(Color(0, 0, 0))
+			uvs.append(Vector2(0, 0))
+			tail_rings += 1
+		# (the loft writes UV2 only for facets: set the tail's along-ness after)
+		var from := body.v.size()
+		loft(pts, rad, cols, uvs, 8)
+		for i in range(from, body.v.size()):
+			var t := clampf((body.v[i].z - start.z) / CosmosAeromanta.TAIL, 0.0, 1.0)
+			body.uv2[i] = Vector2(maxf(t, 0.002), 0.0)
hunks.title: The aeromanta model
hunks.note: A lofted disc of airfoil sections, cephalic fins, eyes, a dorsal and pelvic fins and a whip tail, all one surface shared by every aeromanta.

bubbles.text: Starts the build on a worker the first time one is needed; later calls do nothing.
Turns the worker's arrays into the shared mesh, with a widened AABB so the waves and tail never get culled.
The disc's swept leading edge and concave trailing edge at each point across the span.
A domed body in the middle thinning to the falcate wing tips.
Rings across the span, each a closed airfoil, make the disc that is the wings.

files.explanation: New: the life of the roads - towns make and use goods, caravans carry them between towns, and couriers, pilgrims and patrols travel too; far away they're just numbers, near you they walk as travellers, and raiders and beasts attack them.

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,665 @@ 
+class_name CosmosCaravans
+extends Node
+## The life of a world's roads (CosmosRoads) in the 3D game: its logistics and
+## its travellers.
+##   Logistics - each town makes a few goods (a village its farms' and herds':
+##     grain, oil, wine, cheese, wool...; a city its workshops': pottery, tools,
+##     cloth, bronze...) and uses up what it doesn't make: a stock per town
+##     (stock_of). Caravans load what their town has most of and the town they
+##     make for has least, carry it there along the roads and unload it.
+##   Travellers - caravans (traders, their guards, pack donkeys), couriers
+##     running between towns, pilgrims bound for a city's shrine, patrols of
+##     armed guards. Far from you each is only a place along its road over time
+##     (a few numbers, SIM_HZ times a second); within NEAR they're there -
+##     CosmosTraveller and the donkeys (CosmosCreature, driven along) walking
+##     in a column - and gone back into numbers past GONE.
+##   Hostiles - raiders out of the pirates' camps fall on travellers passing
+##     near (a raid you see: CosmosTraveller raiders run in; one out of your
+##     sight: the odds of its guards against them - robbed, its remains left
+##     in the road: CosmosLoot.drop_wreck), and hunting beasts go for them
+##     (driven at them here; their bites dealt here). The guards fight, the
+##     rest run; the dead drop their loot (CosmosLoot). The event log notes
+##     what you witness. Shoot at a caravan and its guards turn on you.
+## Nothing of it is saved: each world's starts afresh, from its seed, each session.
+##   CosmosCaravans.attach(cosmos)   # (and its roads and loot)
+
+const NEAR := 320.0             # m: a group's people out within this of you
+const GONE := 360.0             # ...and back to numbers past this (Cosmos frees npcs past 390)
+const SIM_HZ := 2.0
+const COLUMN := 3.4             # m between people in a column
+const CAMP_NEAR := 900.0        # m: a pirate camp this near: its raiders after travellers
+const CAMP_RAID := 0.12         # raids a minute on a group near a camp, out of your sight
+const WILD_RAID := 0.004        # ...and anywhere else
+const SEEN_RAID := 0.5          # the chance a group you come near is ambushed while you watch (near a camp; a quarter of it elsewhere)
+const PER_KM := 0.7             # groups on the roads a km of road
+const CARAVAN_CLASS := "res://scripts/world/life/cosmos_caravans.gd"
+
+const MAKES := {
+	"village": ["grain", "olive_oil", "wine", "cheese", "honey", "figs", "wool", "timber", "lentils", "dried_fish"],
+	"city": ["pottery", "tools", "clothing", "bronze_ingots", "glassware", "linen", "furniture", "perfume", "jewellery"],
+}
+const KINDS := [["caravan", 0.5], ["patrol", 0.17], ["courier", 0.15], ["pilgrims", 0.18]]
+
+static var _worlds := {}        # planet key (CosmosRoads._pid) -> its roads' life
+
+var cosmos: Node
+var _sim_t := 0.0
+var _queue: Array = []          # [group, member index or -1 (a raider), planet] - put in one a frame
+var _bites := {}                # creature instance id -> s till it bites again
+var _rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+
+
+## The Cosmos's caravans (and its roads and loot): made as its children the first time.
+static func attach(c: Node) -> CosmosCaravans:
+	CosmosRoads.of(c)
+	CosmosLoot.of(c)
+	var n := c.get_node_or_null("Caravans") as CosmosCaravans
+	if n == null:
+		n = load(CARAVAN_CLASS).new()
+		n.name = "Caravans"
+		n.cosmos = c
+		c.add_child(n)
+	return n
+
+
+## A world's roads' life ({} until its roads are made).
+static func world_of(pl: CosmosPlanet) -> Dictionary:
+	return _worlds.get(CosmosRoads._pid(pl), {}) if pl else {}
+
+
+## What town `i` of `pl` has in store: good -> how much.
+static func stock_of(pl: CosmosPlanet, i: int) -> Dictionary:
+	var w := world_of(pl)
+	return w["stock"][i] if not w.is_empty() and i < (w["stock"] as Array).size() else {}
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	process_priority = -10   # (before the creatures: the donkeys and the beasts driven, then they move)
+	_rng.randomize()
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if cosmos == null or not cosmos.get("built"):
+		return
+	delta = minf(delta, 0.1)
+	var roads := CosmosRoads.of(cosmos)
+	var f: Node3D = cosmos.focus()
+	if f == null:
+		return
+	var life: CosmosPlanet = cosmos.life_planet()
+	if cosmos.get("dungeon") != null:
+		life = null   # (under the ground: the roads' people wait)
+	_sim_t += delta
+	var sim := _sim_t >= 1.0 / SIM_HZ
+	var dt := _sim_t
+	if sim:
+		_sim_t = 0.0
+	for pl: CosmosPlanet in cosmos.planets:
+		var rl: Array = roads.roads_of(pl)
+		if rl.is_empty():
+			continue
+		var w := _world(pl, rl)
+		if sim:
+			_simulate(w, pl, rl, dt)
+		if pl == life:
+			_near(w, pl, rl, f.global_position - pl.global_position)
+			_live(w, pl, rl, delta)
+		else:
+			for g in w["groups"]:
+				if g["out"]:
+					_put_away(g)
+	if not _queue.is_empty():
+		_put_in(_queue.pop_front())
+
+
+# --- The worlds' logistics, simulated -------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _world(pl: CosmosPlanet, rl: Array) -> Dictionary:
+	var key := CosmosRoads._pid(pl)
+	if _worlds.has(key):
+		return _worlds[key]
+	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+	rng.seed = int(pl.rec.get("seed", 1)) * 71 + 3
+	var w := {"groups": [], "stock": [], "makes": [], "next": 0, "rng": rng, "add_t": 60.0}
+	for s in pl.towns:
+		var pool: Array = (MAKES[str(s["kind"])] as Array).duplicate()
+		var makes: Array = []
+		for k in 3:
+			makes.append(pool.pop_at(rng.randi() % pool.size()))
+		w["makes"].append(makes)
+		var st := {}
+		for g in makes:
+			st[g] = float(rng.randi_range(14, 40))
+		w["stock"].append(st)
+	var total := 0.0
+	for r in rl:
+		total += float(r["length"])
+	w["want"] = clampi(roundi(total / 1000.0 * PER_KM), rl.size(), 18)
+	for i in int(w["want"]):
+		var k := rng.randi() % rl.size()
+		_new_group(w, pl, rl, k, 1 if rng.randf() < 0.5 else -1, rng.randf() * float(rl[k]["length"]))
+	_worlds[key] = w
+	return w
+
+
+## A group on road k heading `dir` (+1 to its b end, -1 to its a end), `s` m along it.
+func _new_group(w: Dictionary, pl: CosmosPlanet, rl: Array, k: int, dir: int, s: float, kind := "") -> Dictionary:
+	var rng: RandomNumberGenerator = w["rng"]
+	if kind == "":
+		var x := rng.randf()
+		for kk in KINDS:
+			x -= float(kk[1])
+			if x <= 0.0:
+				kind = kk[0]
+				break
+		if kind == "":
+			kind = "caravan"
+	var members: Array = []
+	var speed := 1.35
+	match kind:
+		"caravan":
+			for i in rng.randi_range(1, 2):
+				members.append({"role": "guard"})
+			for i in rng.randi_range(1, 2):
+				members.append({"role": "trader"})
+			for i in rng.randi_range(1, 2):
+				members.append({"role": "donkey"})
+			if rng.randf() < 0.5:
+				members.append({"role": "guard"})   # (one at the back)
+		"patrol":
+			for i in rng.randi_range(2, 3):
+				members.append({"role": "guard"})
+			speed = 1.6
+		"courier":
+			members.append({"role": "courier"})
+			speed = 3.6
+		"pilgrims":
+			for i in rng.randi_range(2, 4):
+				members.append({"role": "pilgrim"})
+			speed = 1.1
+	for m in members:
+		m["seed"] = rng.randi()
+		m["hp"] = -1.0
+		m["goods"] = {}
+		m["dead"] = false
+	var g := {"id": int(w["next"]), "kind": kind, "road": k, "dir": dir, "s": s, "speed": speed, "members": members,
+		"halt": 0.0, "out": false, "nodes": [], "angry": false, "ambush": -1.0, "raiders": [], "raid": false, "seen": {},
+		"empire": str(pl.towns[0].get("empire", ""))}
+	w["next"] = int(w["next"]) + 1
+	_titled(g, pl, rl)
+	if kind == "caravan":
+		_load(w, g, _from(g, rl), _dest(g, rl))
+	elif kind == "courier":
+		g["members"][0]["goods"] = {"papyrus": rng.randi_range(1, 3)}
+	elif kind == "pilgrims":
+		for m in members:
+			m["goods"] = {"incense": 1}
+	w["groups"].append(g)
+	return g
+
+
+static func _dest(g: Dictionary, rl: Array) -> int:
+	return int(rl[g["road"]]["b"] if int(g["dir"]) > 0 else rl[g["road"]]["a"])
+
+
+static func _from(g: Dictionary, rl: Array) -> int:
+	return int(rl[g["road"]]["a"] if int(g["dir"]) > 0 else rl[g["road"]]["b"])
+
+
+func _titled(g: Dictionary, pl: CosmosPlanet, rl: Array) -> void:
+	var to := str(pl.towns[_dest(g, rl)]["name"])
+	g["title"] = {"caravan": "caravan to %s", "patrol": "patrol on the road to %s", "courier": "courier bound for %s",
+		"pilgrims": "pilgrims on the way to %s"}[g["kind"]] % to
+
+
+## A caravan loaded at town `from`: what it has most of that town `to` has least of.
+func _load(w: Dictionary, g: Dictionary, from: int, to: int) -> void:
+	var here: Dictionary = w["stock"][from]
+	var there: Dictionary = w["stock"][to]
+	var goods: Array = (w["makes"][from] as Array).duplicate()
+	goods.sort_custom(func(a, b): return float(here.get(a, 0.0)) - float(there.get(a, 0.0)) > float(here.get(b, 0.0)) - float(there.get(b, 0.0)))
+	var carriers: Array = (g["members"] as Array).filter(func(m): return m["role"] in ["donkey", "trader"] and not m["dead"])
+	if carriers.is_empty():
+		return
+	var ci := 0
+	for good in goods.slice(0, 2):
+		var have := float(here.get(good, 0.0))
+		var n := mini(int(have - 4.0), 12)
+		if n <= 0:
+			continue
+		here[good] = have - n
+		while n > 0:   # (shared out: the donkeys the most)
+			var m: Dictionary = carriers[ci % carriers.size()]
+			var k := mini(n, 6 if m["role"] == "donkey" else 3)
+			m["goods"][good] = int(m["goods"].get(good, 0)) + k
+			n -= k
+			ci += 1
+
+
+## Arrived: its load into the town's stock, then off along another of its roads.
+func _arrive(w: Dictionary, g: Dictionary, pl: CosmosPlanet, rl: Array) -> void:
+	var town := _dest(g, rl)
+	var st: Dictionary = w["stock"][town]
+	for m in g["members"]:
+		if m["role"] in ["donkey", "trader"]:
+			for good in m["goods"]:
+				st[good] = float(st.get(good, 0.0)) + float(m["goods"][good])
+			(m["goods"] as Dictionary).clear()
+	var rng: RandomNumberGenerator = w["rng"]
+	var best := -1
+	var bs := -INF
+	for k in rl.size():
+		if int(rl[k]["a"]) != town and int(rl[k]["b"]) != town:
+			continue
+		var other := int(rl[k]["b"]) if int(rl[k]["a"]) == town else int(rl[k]["a"])
+		var score := rng.randf() * 6.0
+		if g["kind"] == "caravan":   # (where its goods are wanted most)
+			for good in w["makes"][town]:
+				score += float(st.get(good, 0.0)) - float((w["stock"][other] as Dictionary).get(good, 0.0))
+		elif g["kind"] == "pilgrims" and str(pl.towns[other]["kind"]) == "city":
+			score += 20.0
+		if k == int(g["road"]) and rl.size() > 1:
+			score -= 8.0   # (not straight back the way it came, if there's another way)
+		if score > bs:
+			bs = score
+			best = k
+	if best < 0:
+		g["gone"] = true
+		return
+	g["road"] = best
+	g["dir"] = 1 if int(rl[best]["a"]) == town else -1
+	g["s"] = 0.0 if int(g["dir"]) > 0 else float(rl[best]["length"])
+	g["halt"] = rng.randf_range(20.0, 60.0)
+	_titled(g, pl, rl)
+	if g["kind"] == "caravan":
+		_load(w, g, town, _dest(g, rl))
+
+
+func _simulate(w: Dictionary, pl: CosmosPlanet, rl: Array, dt: float) -> void:
+	var rng: RandomNumberGenerator = w["rng"]
+	# (the towns' making and using: a unit a minute of each good it makes, a third of one of the rest)
+	for i in (w["stock"] as Array).size():
+		var st: Dictionary = w["stock"][i]
+		for good in w["makes"][i]:
+			st[good] = minf(float(st.get(good, 0.0)) + dt / 60.0, 80.0)
+		for good in st:
+			if not good in w["makes"][i]:
+				st[good] = maxf(float(st[good]) - dt / 180.0, 0.0)
+	var camps: Array = cosmos.camps_of(pl) if cosmos.has_method("camps_of") else []
+	for g in w["groups"]:
+		if g["out"]:
+			continue
+		if float(g["halt"]) > 0.0:
+			g["halt"] = float(g["halt"]) - dt
+			continue
+		var L := float(rl[g["road"]]["length"])
+		g["s"] = float(g["s"]) + int(g["dir"]) * float(g["speed"]) * dt
+		if (int(g["dir"]) > 0 and float(g["s"]) >= L) or (int(g["dir"]) < 0 and float(g["s"]) <= 0.0):
+			g["s"] = clampf(float(g["s"]), 0.0, L)
+			_arrive(w, g, pl, rl)
+			continue
+		# Out of your sight, raiders and their odds.
+		var at := where(pl, rl, g, float(g["s"]))
+		var p := WILD_RAID
+		for c in camps:
+			if (c[0] as Vector3).distance_to(at) < CAMP_NEAR:
+				p = CAMP_RAID
+				break
+		if rng.randf() < p * dt / 60.0:
+			_far_raid(g, pl, at, rng)
+	for g in w["groups"]:
+		if g.get("gone", false) and g["out"]:
+			_put_away(g)
+	w["groups"] = (w["groups"] as Array).filter(func(g): return not g.get("gone", false))
+	# New travellers out of the towns, while the roads have fewer than they should.
+	w["add_t"] = float(w["add_t"]) - dt
+	if float(w["add_t"]) <= 0.0:
+		w["add_t"] = rng.randf_range(90.0, 240.0)
+		if (w["groups"] as Array).size() < int(w["want"]):
+			var k := rng.randi() % rl.size()
+			var dir := 1 if rng.randf() < 0.5 else -1
+			var g := _new_group(w, pl, rl, k, dir, 0.0 if dir > 0 else float(rl[k]["length"]))
+			g["halt"] = rng.randf_range(5.0, 30.0)
+
+
+## A raid out of your sight: its guards against the raiders - driven off (and
+## maybe one of them lost), or robbed to the last, its remains in the road.
+func _far_raid(g: Dictionary, pl: CosmosPlanet, at: Vector3, rng: RandomNumberGenerator) -> void:
+	var guards := (g["members"] as Array).filter(func(m): return m["role"] == "guard" and not m["dead"]).size()
+	var win := clampf(0.2 + 0.22 * guards, 0.1, 0.9)
+	if rng.randf() < win:
+		if rng.randf() < 0.3:
+			var alive: Array = (g["members"] as Array).filter(func(m): return not m["dead"])
+			if alive.size() > 1:
+				alive[rng.randi() % alive.size()]["dead"] = true
+		g["members"] = (g["members"] as Array).filter(func(m): return not m["dead"])
+		return
+	var loot := {"credits": rng.randi_range(10, 60)}
+	for m in g["members"]:
+		for good in m["goods"]:
+			loot[good] = int(loot.get(good, 0)) + int(m["goods"][good]) / 2   # (what the raiders left of it)
+	for good in loot.keys():
+		if int(loot[good]) <= 0:
+			loot.erase(good)
+	CosmosLoot.of(cosmos).drop_wreck(pl, at, "remains of the %s" % str(g["title"]), loot)
+	g["gone"] = true
+
+
+## Where a group's `s` m along its road is (planet-local), `side` m to its right.
+static func where(pl: CosmosPlanet, rl: Array, g: Dictionary, s: float, side := 0.0) -> Vector3:
+	var road: Dictionary = rl[g["road"]]
+	var d := CosmosRoads.point(road, s)
+	if side != 0.0:
+		var ahead := CosmosRoads.point(road, s + 1.5 * int(g["dir"]))
+		var right := (ahead - d).cross(d)
+		if right.length() > 1e-9:
+			d = (d * pl.radius + right.normalized() * side).normalized()
+	return d * (pl.radius + maxf(pl.shape.height(d), 0.0))
+
+
+# --- Near you: its people there ------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _near(w: Dictionary, pl: CosmosPlanet, rl: Array, here: Vector3) -> void:
+	for g in w["groups"]:
+		var d := where(pl, rl, g, float(g["s"])).distance_to(here)
+		if not g["out"] and d < NEAR:
+			_put_out(g, pl, rl, here)
+		elif g["out"] and d > GONE:
+			_put_away(g)
+
+
+func _put_out(g: Dictionary, pl: CosmosPlanet, rl: Array, _here: Vector3) -> void:
+	g["out"] = true
+	g["pl"] = pl
+	g["nodes"] = []
+	(g["nodes"] as Array).resize((g["members"] as Array).size())
+	for i in (g["members"] as Array).size():
+		if not g["members"][i]["dead"]:
+			_queue.append([g, i, pl])
+	# (will raiders fall on it while you watch? likelier near a pirates' camp)
+	var at := where(pl, rl, g, float(g["s"]))
+	var camp := _camp_near(pl, at)
+	var p := SEEN_RAID if camp != Vector3.INF else SEEN_RAID * 0.25
+	g["ambush"] = _rng.randf_range(12.0, 45.0) if _rng.randf() < p and g["kind"] != "patrol" and not g.get("raided", false) else -1.0
+
+
+func _camp_near(pl: CosmosPlanet, at: Vector3) -> Vector3:
+	if not cosmos.has_method("camps_of"):
+		return Vector3.INF
+	var best := Vector3.INF
+	var bd := CAMP_NEAR
+	for c in cosmos.camps_of(pl):
+		var d := (c[0] as Vector3).distance_to(at)
+		if d < bd:
+			bd = d
+			best = c[0]
+	return best
+
+
+## Back into numbers: its people's health and loads kept, the dead gone.
+func _put_away(g: Dictionary) -> void:
+	for i in (g["nodes"] as Array).size():
+		var n = g["nodes"][i]
+		if n != null and is_instance_valid(n):
+			var m: Dictionary = g["members"][i]
+			if n.get("dead"):
+				m["dead"] = true
+			else:
+				m["hp"] = float(n.get("hp"))
+				n.queue_free()
+	for r in g["raiders"]:
+		if is_instance_valid(r) and not r.get("dead"):
+			r.queue_free()
+	g["raiders"] = []
+	g["nodes"] = []
+	g["out"] = false
+	_queue = _queue.filter(func(q): return not is_same(q[0], g))
+	g["members"] = (g["members"] as Array).filter(func(m): return not m["dead"])
+	if (g["members"] as Array).filter(func(m): return m["role"] != "donkey").is_empty():
+		g["gone"] = true
+
+
+## One of a group's people (or a raider: index -1) put in the world.
+func _put_in(q: Array) -> void:
+	var g: Dictionary = q[0]
+	var i: int = q[1]
+	var pl: CosmosPlanet = q[2]
+	if not g["out"] or not is_instance_valid(pl):
+		return
+	var rl: Array = CosmosRoads.of(cosmos).roads_of(pl)
+	if rl.is_empty():
+		return
+	var world: Node3D = cosmos.world
+	if i < 0:   # (a raider: out of the camp's side of the road)
+		var r := CosmosTraveller.new()
+		r.cosmos = cosmos
+		r.traveller(pl, "raider", "pirates", _rng.randi())
+		world.add_child(r)
+		var at: Vector3 = q[3]
+		var d := at.normalized()
+		r.global_position = pl.global_position + d * (pl.radius + maxf(pl.shape.height(d), 0.0))
+		cosmos.npcs.append(r)
+		g["raiders"].append(r)
+		return
+	var m: Dictionary = g["members"][i]
+	var slot := _slot(g, i)
+	var local := where(pl, rl, g, float(g["s"]) - int(g["dir"]) * COLUMN * slot, _lane(g, i))
+	if m["role"] == "donkey":
+		var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+		rng.seed = int(m["seed"])
+		var k := CosmosFauna.species("donkey", rng)
+		var c := CosmosCreature.new()
+		c.cosmos = cosmos
+		c.setup(k, pl, int(m["seed"]))
+		c.set_meta("goods", m["goods"])
+		c.set_meta("loot_title", "pack donkey")
+		c.set_meta("caravan", g["id"])
+		world.add_child(c)
+		c.global_position = pl.global_position + local
+		if float(m["hp"]) > 0.0:
+			c.hp = float(m["hp"])
+		cosmos.creatures.append(c)
+		g["nodes"][i] = c
+		return
+	var t := CosmosTraveller.new()
+	t.cosmos = cosmos
+	t.traveller(pl, str(m["role"]), str(g["empire"]), int(m["seed"]))
+	t.group = g
+	t.goods = m["goods"]
+	t.speed = float(g["speed"])
+	if float(m["hp"]) > 0.0:
+		t.hp = float(m["hp"])
+	world.add_child(t)
+	t.global_position = pl.global_position + local
+	cosmos.npcs.append(t)
+	g["nodes"][i] = t
+
+
+## Its place in the column (0 the front) and its side of the road.
+static func _slot(g: Dictionary, i: int) -> float:
+	return float(i) * (0.55 if g["kind"] == "pilgrims" else 1.0)
+
+
+static func _lane(g: Dictionary, i: int) -> float:
+	if g["kind"] == "pilgrims":
+		return -0.8 if i % 2 == 0 else 0.8
+	return -0.7 if i % 2 == 0 else 0.7
+
+
+## Each frame, a group that's out: along its road while all's well (the column
+## kept together), halted while it fights; its donkeys driven, the beasts at it,
+## the raiders' ambush, what you see of it in the event log.
+func _live(w: Dictionary, pl: CosmosPlanet, rl: Array, delta: float) -> void:
+	for g in w["groups"]:
+		if not g["out"]:
+			continue
+		var nodes: Array = g["nodes"]
+		var fight := false
+		var lag := 0.0
+		var alive := 0
+		for i in nodes.size():
+			var n = nodes[i]
+			if n == null:
+				continue
+			if not is_instance_valid(n):
+				nodes[i] = null
+				continue
+			var m: Dictionary = g["members"][i]
+			if n.get("dead"):
+				if not m["dead"]:
+					m["dead"] = true
+					_say(g, "A %s of the %s is killed" % [_who(m), str(g["title"])], "kill:%d" % i)
+				continue
+			if m["role"] != "donkey":
+				alive += 1
+				if n.get("threat") != null:
+					fight = true
+			var goal: Vector3 = n.get("goal") if n is CosmosTraveller else Vector3.INF
+			if goal != Vector3.INF:
+				lag = maxf(lag, (n as Node3D).global_position.distance_to(goal))
+		var queued := _queue.any(func(q): return is_same(q[0], g))
+		if alive == 0 and not queued:
+			if (g["members"] as Array).any(func(m): return m["dead"] and m["role"] != "donkey"):
+				_say(g, "The %s is wiped out - its goods lie in the road" % str(g["title"]), "wiped")
+			_put_away(g)
+			continue
+		g["raiders"] = (g["raiders"] as Array).filter(func(r): return is_instance_valid(r))
+		var raiders_up := (g["raiders"] as Array).filter(func(r): return not r.get("dead")).size()
+		if g["raid"] and raiders_up == 0 and not _queue.any(func(q): return is_same(q[0], g) and q[1] < 0):
+			g["raid"] = false
+			_say(g, "The %s drives off its raiders" % str(g["title"]), "won")
+		fight = fight or raiders_up > 0
+		# Along the road, the column kept together (the slowest not left behind).
+		if not fight and not queued:
+			if float(g["halt"]) > 0.0:
+				g["halt"] = float(g["halt"]) - delta
+			else:
+				var rate := 1.0 if lag < 3.0 else (0.35 if lag < 7.0 else 0.0)
+				var L := float(rl[g["road"]]["length"])
+				g["s"] = float(g["s"]) + int(g["dir"]) * float(g["speed"]) * rate * delta
+				if (int(g["dir"]) > 0 and float(g["s"]) >= L) or (int(g["dir"]) < 0 and float(g["s"]) <= 0.0):
+					g["s"] = clampf(float(g["s"]), 0.0, L)
+					_arrive(w, g, pl, rl)
+		for i in nodes.size():
+			var n = nodes[i]
+			if n == null or not is_instance_valid(n) or n.get("dead"):
+				continue
+			var local := where(pl, rl, g, float(g["s"]) - int(g["dir"]) * COLUMN * _slot(g, i), _lane(g, i))
+			var goal := pl.global_position + local
+			if n is CosmosTraveller:
+				(n as CosmosTraveller).goal = goal
+			else:
+				_drive(n, goal, 0.0 if fight else float(g["speed"]))
+		# The raiders' ambush, if one's coming.
+		if float(g["ambush"]) > 0.0 and not fight:
+			g["ambush"] = float(g["ambush"]) - delta
+			if float(g["ambush"]) <= 0.0:
+				_ambush(g, pl, rl)
+		_beasts(g, nodes)
+
+
+func _who(m: Dictionary) -> String:
+	return {"guard": "guard", "trader": "trader", "donkey": "pack donkey", "courier": "courier", "pilgrim": "pilgrim"}.get(m["role"], "traveller")
+
+
+## A note in the event log (once each thing a group: `key`).
+func _say(g: Dictionary, text: String, key: String) -> void:
+	if (g["seen"] as Dictionary).has(key):
+		return
+	g["seen"][key] = true
+	if cosmos and cosmos.get("hud"):
+		cosmos.hud.flash(text, 3.5)
+	else:
+		GameLog.post(text, "info")
+
+
+## A donkey led to `goal` (CosmosCreature: its own wandering held off - idle, its
+## velocity set here; it walks, its gait from that).
+func _drive(c: Node, goal: Vector3, speed: float) -> void:
+	var cr := c as CosmosCreature
+	if cr == null or cr.dead:
+		return
+	cr.state = "idle"
+	cr._t = 5.0
+	var u := cr.up()
+	var to := goal - cr.global_position
+	to -= u * to.dot(u)
+	var d := to.length()
+	cr.velocity = to / d * clampf(d * 1.2, 0.0, maxf(speed * 1.8, 0.5)) if d > 0.4 and speed > 0.0 else Vector3.ZERO
+
+
+## Raiders out of the nearest camp's side of the road, running in.
+func _ambush(g: Dictionary, pl: CosmosPlanet, rl: Array) -> void:
+	g["raid"] = true
+	g["raided"] = true
+	var at := where(pl, rl, g, float(g["s"]))
+	var u := at.normalized()
+	var camp := _camp_near(pl, at)
+	var side: Vector3
+	if camp != Vector3.INF:
+		side = camp - at
+		side -= u * side.dot(u)
+	if camp == Vector3.INF or side.length() < 1.0:
+		side = u.cross(Vector3.UP if absf(u.y) < 0.9 else Vector3.RIGHT).rotated(u, _rng.randf() * TAU)
+	side = side.normalized()
+	var n := _rng.randi_range(2, 4)
+	for k in n:
+		var off := side.rotated(u, _rng.randf_range(-0.5, 0.5)) * _rng.randf_range(48.0, 66.0)
+		_queue.append([g, -1, pl, at + off])
+	_say(g, "Raiders from a pirates' camp fall on the %s!" % str(g["title"]), "raid")
+
+
+## The hunting beasts near a group go for its people (yours to deal with if they're
+## hunting you: then left to their own) - driven at the nearest, their bites dealt here.
+func _beasts(g: Dictionary, nodes: Array) -> void:
+	var w: Node3D = cosmos.walker
+	var lead: Node3D = null
+	for n in nodes:
+		if n != null and is_instance_valid(n) and not n.get("dead"):
+			lead = n
+			break
+	if lead == null:
+		return
+	for c in cosmos.creatures:
+		if not is_instance_valid(c) or c.dead or c.kind.get("temper") != "predator" or c.has_meta("caravan"):
+			continue
+		if c.global_position.distance_to(lead.global_position) > 48.0:
+			continue
+		var sight := 38.0 * (1.4 if c.kind.get("monster", false) else 1.0)
+		if w and w.get("deck") == null and not w.get("downed") and c.global_position.distance_to(w.global_position) < sight * 1.1:
+			continue   # (it's after you)
+		var prey: Node3D = null
+		var pd := INF
+		for n in nodes:
+			if n == null or not is_instance_valid(n) or n.get("dead"):
+				continue
+			var d: float = (n as Node3D).global_position.distance_to(c.global_position)
+			if d < pd:
+				pd = d
+				prey = n
+		if prey == null:
+			continue
+		_say(g, "A %s attacks the %s!" % [CosmosFauna.label(c.kind).to_lower() if c.kind.has("id") else str(c.kind["name"]), str(g["title"])], "beast:%d" % c.get_instance_id())
+		c.state = "idle"
+		c._t = 3.0
+		var u: Vector3 = c.up()
+		var to: Vector3 = prey.global_position - c.global_position
+		to -= u * to.dot(u)
+		var bite_at: float = float(c.reach) + 1.0
+		c.velocity = to.normalized() * float(c.kind["run"]) if to.length() > bite_at else Vector3.ZERO
+		if to.length() > 0.1:
+			c.facing = to.normalized()
+		var id: int = c.get_instance_id()
+		_bites[id] = float(_bites.get(id, 0.0)) - get_process_delta_time()
+		if to.length() <= bite_at + 0.3 and float(_bites[id]) <= 0.0:
+			_bites[id] = 1.2
+			prey.hurt(float(c.kind["bite"]), c.global_position)
+
+
+func _exit_tree() -> void:
+	for key in _worlds:
+		for g in _worlds[key]["groups"]:
+			g["out"] = false
+			g["nodes"] = []
+			g["raiders"] = []
+	_queue.clear()

+## A dragonfly: one mesh (its body and four wings - two surfaces), shared by
+## them all; its own two materials (the flash, the beat). The mesh is made on a
+## worker - until it's ready nothing shows.
+func _dragonfly(k: Dictionary) -> void:
+	var mats := CosmosDragonfly.materials(k["c1"], k["c2"])
+	_mat = mats[0]
+	_wmat = mats[1]
+	_fly = MeshInstance3D.new()
+	_fly.visibility_range_end = 220.0
+	_body.add_child(_fly)
+	_head = Node3D.new()   # (its head part of the one mesh: nothing to turn)
+	_body.add_child(_head)
+	_beat = _rng.randf() * TAU
+	_dart_t = _rng.randf_range(0.3, 1.5)

+	if CosmosDragonfly.is_ready():

+		CosmosDragonfly.start()

+
+
+func _fly_attach() -> void:
+	_fly_wait = false
+	_fly.mesh = CosmosDragonfly.mesh()
+	_fly.set_surface_override_material(0, _mat)
+	_fly.set_surface_override_material(1, _wmat)
+
+
+## A red fox: one skinned mesh (one surface) shared by them all - made on a
+## worker, nothing shown until it's ready - on its own skeleton, which its Rig poses.
+func _fox_build(k: Dictionary) -> void:
+	_mat = CosmosFox.material(k["c1"], k["c2"])
+	_body.position.y = 0.0   # (its model stands on the ground)
+	var sk := CosmosFox.skeleton()
+	_body.add_child(sk)
+	_fox = MeshInstance3D.new()
+	_fox.visibility_range_end = 220.0

+
+
+func _fox_attach() -> void:
+	_fox_wait = false
+	_fox.mesh = CosmosFox.mesh()
+	_fox.material_override = _mat
+
+
+## An aeromanta: one mesh of one surface, shared by them all (made on a worker -
+## nothing shows until it's ready), its own material (the flash, the waves).
+func _aeromanta(k: Dictionary) -> void:
+	_mat = CosmosAeromanta.material(k["c1"], k["c2"])

+	_ray.visibility_range_end = 260.0
+	_body.add_child(_ray)

+	_body.add_child(_head)

+
+func _ray_attach() -> void:

+
+## The aeromanta swimming the air: bouts of strokes - waves rolling out along
+## its wings - and long glides between them (fleeing, strokes all the way);
+## banking into its turns, pitching a little with the beat, its tail trailing
+## the turn.
+func _ray_motion(delta: float, flat: Vector3, d: Vector3) -> void:

+		_dart_t = _rng.randf_range(2.5, 5.0) if _stroking else _rng.randf_range(3.0, 7.0)

+	_beat = fmod(_beat + delta * lerpf(1.0, 2.6 if hard else 2.0, clampf(_wave, 0.0, 1.0)), TAU * 64.0)
+	var acc := (flat - _last_flat) / maxf(delta, 1e-4)

+class_name CosmosDragonfly
+extends RefCounted
+## The dragonfly (CosmosFauna "dragonfly", kind "model": "dragonfly") - its own
+## model, not the generic flyer: a true Anisoptera at the species' size, in one
+## shared mesh of two surfaces (one draw call each, every dragonfly the same mesh):
+##  - the body: a head that is mostly two wrap-around compound eyes (their facets
+##    drawn by the shader from UV2), a face, short antennae; a robust slanted
+##    thorax; six thin jointed legs folded forward under it; a long abdomen of ten
+##    tapering segments (UV.x: how far along it - its flex; UV.y: segment + place
+##    in it - the joints and spots); the claspers at its tip. COLOR: r eye, g dark
+##    chitin, b thorax. Metallic and iridescent (dragonfly.gdshader).
+##  - the wings: four long narrow ones, the hind pair broader at the base, glassy,
+##    veined, a dark stigma near each tip (dragonfly_wing.gdshader); UV: (along
+##    the span, across the chord), UV2: (side, 0 fore / 1 hind) - the shader beats
+##    them round their hinges, fore and hind out of phase.
+## Built on a worker (start() when the species is designed; mesh() waits for it).
+## Unit space: CosmosCreature scales it by the species' size; forward is -z.
+
+const BODY_SHADER := preload("res://shaders/world/dragonfly.gdshader")
+const WING_SHADER := preload("res://shaders/world/dragonfly_wing.gdshader")
+const WING_LEN := 0.9
+const FORE_HINGE := Vector3(0.028, 0.112, -0.44)
+const HIND_HINGE := Vector3(0.028, 0.106, -0.335)
+const ABDOMEN := [0.045, 0.092, 0.122, 0.12, 0.118, 0.116, 0.112, 0.1, 0.08, 0.06]   # (the ten segments' lengths)
+const ABD_START := -0.275
+const ABD_END := 0.8
+
+static var _mesh: ArrayMesh
+static var _task := -1
+static var _built: Builder
+## What the last build made (the tests read it): {"legs", "wings", "segments", "build_ms"}.
+static var made := {}
+
+
+## Begin making the mesh on a worker (nothing if made or under way).
+static func start() -> void:
+	if _mesh != null or _task >= 0:
+		return
+	_built = Builder.new()
+	_task = WorkerThreadPool.add_task(_built.run, false, "dragonfly mesh")
+
+
+## The mesh made (or its task finished: mesh() then costs only the upload).
+static func is_ready() -> bool:
+	return _mesh != null or (_task >= 0 and WorkerThreadPool.is_task_completed(_task))
+
+
+static func mesh() -> ArrayMesh:
+	if _mesh == null:
+		start()
+		WorkerThreadPool.wait_for_task_completion(_task)
+		_task = -1
+		var m := ArrayMesh.new()
+		m.add_surface_from_arrays(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES, _built.body.arrays())
+		m.add_surface_from_arrays(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES, _built.wings.arrays())
+		m.custom_aabb = AABB(Vector3(-1.0, -0.4, -0.9), Vector3(2.0, 1.2, 1.9))   # (the beating wings inside)
+		made = {"legs": _built.legs, "wings": _built.wing_n, "segments": _built.segments, "build_ms": _built.ms}
+		_built = null
+		_mesh = m
+	return _mesh
+
+
+## Its two materials, one dragonfly's own (its hit flash, its wings' beat): [body, wings].
+static func materials(c1: Color, c2: Color) -> Array:

+	b.shader = BODY_SHADER

+	b.set_shader_parameter("c2", c2)

+	var w := ShaderMaterial.new()
+	w.shader = WING_SHADER

+				n[b] += f

+		arr.resize(Mesh.ARRAY_MAX)
+		arr[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX] = v
+		arr[Mesh.ARRAY_NORMAL] = n
+		arr[Mesh.ARRAY_COLOR] = col
+		arr[Mesh.ARRAY_TEX_UV] = uv
+		arr[Mesh.ARRAY_TEX_UV2] = uv2
+		arr[Mesh.ARRAY_INDEX] = idx

+	var segments := 0

+		_thorax()
+		_abdomen()
+		_legs()

+			_wing(side, 0.0)

+	## A tube through `pts` (ellipse radii `rad`: x across, y up), `sides` round,
+	## its ends closed; per ring a colour, a UV and the UV2 its facets need
+	## (`facet` > 0: UV2 = (round, along) / facet).
+	func loft(pts: Array, rad: Array, cols: Array, uvs: Array, sides: int, facet := 0.0) -> void:
+		var p := body

+## Packed arrays (indexed), smooth normals set here. UV.x the glow (> 0.9: rigid),
+## UV.y how far the vertex sways; UV2.x 1 on leaves, UV2.y the fade distance.
+class M:
+	extends RefCounted
+	var v := PackedVector3Array()
+	var nr := PackedVector3Array()
+	var c := PackedColorArray()
+	var uv := PackedVector2Array()
+	var uv2 := PackedVector2Array()
+	var ix := PackedInt32Array()
+	var far := false
+	var lod := 1        # 0 near: twigs and leaves; 1 the crown as clumps; 2 far: no twigs, coarse clumps
+	var leaf_shape := ""   # (near: the clumps' leaves - LEAVES)
+	var bark := Color(0.35, 0.3, 0.25)
+	var silver := false # (leaves pale beneath: olive)
+	var sway := 1.0     # (UV.y = height x this)
+	var leaf := 0.0
+	var fade := 0.0
+	var glow := 0.0
+
+	func add(p: Vector3, n: Vector3, col: Color) -> int:
+		v.append(p)
+		nr.append(n)
+		c.append(col)
+		uv.append(Vector2(glow, maxf(p.y, 0.0) * sway))
+		uv2.append(Vector2(leaf, fade))
+		return v.size() - 1
+
+	## A triangle wound to face its vertices' normals (Godot's front faces wind clockwise).
+	func tri(a: int, b: int, d: int) -> void:
+		var out := nr[a] + nr[b] + nr[d]
+		if (v[d] - v[a]).cross(v[b] - v[a]).dot(out) >= 0.0:
+			ix.append(a); ix.append(b); ix.append(d)
+		else:
+			ix.append(a); ix.append(d); ix.append(b)
+
+	func quad(a: int, b: int, d: int, e: int) -> void:
+		tri(a, b, d)
+		tri(a, d, e)
+
+	## A leaf card: a quad from `p` along `up` (`l` long, `w` wide across `side`)
+	## the shader cuts into leaves of `type` (CARD_*) - UV2.x 3 + u (5 + u: pale
+	## beneath), UV2.y -(1 + 2 type + v).
+	func card(p: Vector3, side: Vector3, up: Vector3, w: float, l: float, n: Vector3, col: Color, type: int) -> void:
+		var base := v.size()
+		var ux := 5.0 if silver else 3.0
+		for k in 4:
+			var u := float(k == 1 or k == 2)
+			var t := float(k >= 2)

+			v.append(pt)

+			c.append(col * (0.8 + 0.25 * t))
+			uv.append(Vector2(glow, maxf(pt.y, 0.0) * sway))
+			uv2.append(Vector2(ux + u * 0.999, -(1.0 + 2.0 * type + t * 0.999)))
+		quad(base, base + 1, base + 2, base + 3)
+
+	func arrays() -> Array:
+		var arr := []
+		arr.resize(Mesh.ARRAY_MAX)
+		arr[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX] = v
+		arr[Mesh.ARRAY_NORMAL] = nr
+		arr[Mesh.ARRAY_COLOR] = c
+		arr[Mesh.ARRAY_TEX_UV] = uv
+		arr[Mesh.ARRAY_TEX_UV2] = uv2
+		arr[Mesh.ARRAY_INDEX] = ix
+		return arr

+			var e := m.add(p + a1 * len, n, cl * 1.08)
+			var f := m.add(p - t2 * len * 0.35, n, cl)
+			m.quad(a, b, e, f)
+	elif not m.far:   # (a tree's: leaf cards on its skin, tilted out - a leafy outline)
+		var type: int = CARD_OF.get(m.leaf_shape, CARD_OVAL)
+		for i in sprays:
+			var u: Vector3 = vs[rr.randi() % vs.size()]
+			var p := c + u * r * rr.randf_range(0.85, 1.0)
+			var out := u
+			var t1 := _perp(out).rotated(out, rr.randf() * TAU)
+			var tilt := rr.randf_range(0.4, 0.9)
+			var up := (t1 * cos(tilt) + out * sin(tilt)).normalized()
+			var n := ((p - cc) / cr).normalized().lerp(out, 0.4).normalized()
+			var side := n.cross(up).normalized()
+			var len := minf(minf(r.x, r.z) * rr.randf_range(0.5, 0.75), 1.0)
+			var hy := clampf((p.y - (cc.y - cr.y)) / (2.0 * cr.y), 0.0, 1.0)
+			var cl := col * ((0.55 + 0.55 * hy) * rr.randf_range(0.85, 1.15))
+			if fleck > 0.0 and rr.randf() < fleck:
+				cl = cl.lerp(fleck_col, 0.5)
+			cl.a = 1.0
+			m.card(p - up * len * 0.3, side, up, len, len, n, cl, type)
+	m.leaf = 0.0
+
+
+## Clumps at the tips, shaded as one crown.
+static func _crown(m: M, rng: RandomNumberGenerator, tips: Array, size: Vector2, flat: float, col: Color, extra: int,
+		fleck := 0.0, fleck_col := Color(), sprays := 11) -> void:
+	if tips.is_empty():
+		return
+	var lo := Vector3(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
+	var hi := -lo
+	for t in tips:
+		lo = lo.min(t[0])
+		hi = hi.max(t[0])
+	var rad := rng.randf_range(size.x, size.y)
+	var cc := (lo + hi) * 0.5
+	if m.far and tips.size() > MAX_CLUMPS:   # (far: a crown of so many clumps at most)
+		tips = tips.duplicate()
+		for i in tips.size():
+			var j := rng.randi() % tips.size()
+			var tmp = tips[i]
+			tips[i] = tips[j]
+			tips[j] = tmp
+		tips.resize(MAX_CLUMPS)
+	var cr := ((hi - lo) * 0.5 + Vector3.ONE * rad).max(Vector3.ONE * 0.5)
+	for t in tips:
+		var r := rad * rng.randf_range(0.75, 1.2) * (minf(pow(float(t[3]), 0.4), 1.7) if t.size() > 3 else 1.0)
+		var seed := rng.randi()
+		var tint := col.lightened(rng.randf_range(-0.07, 0.07))
+		_clump(m, seed, t[0] + (t[1] as Vector3) * r * 0.3, Vector3(r, r * flat, r), tint, cc, cr, sprays, fleck, fleck_col)
+	# (fill: clumps inside the crown - no see-through holes)
+	for i in extra:
+		var p := cc + Vector3(rng.randf_range(-0.6, 0.6) * (cr.x - rad), rng.randf_range(-0.2, 0.5) * (cr.y - rad * flat), rng.randf_range(-0.6, 0.6) * (cr.z - rad))
+		var r := rad * rng.randf_range(0.9, 1.3)
+		var seed := rng.randi()
+		_clump(m, seed, p, Vector3(r, r * flat, r), col.darkened(0.08), cc, cr, sprays / 2, fleck, fleck_col)
+
+
+# --- Leaves (the near meshes) -------------------------------------------------------
+
+const CARD_LANCE := 0     # (the leaf cards' shapes - flora.gdshader cuts them)
+const CARD_OVAL := 1
+const CARD_BROAD := 2
+const CARD_NEEDLES := 3
+const CARD_FAN := 4
+const CARD_OF := {"lance": CARD_LANCE, "oval": CARD_OVAL, "broad": CARD_BROAD, "needles": CARD_NEEDLES}
+
+## Each tree's leaves: lance (olive: narrow, silver beneath), oval (oak, carob),
+## broad (plane, fig: lobed, palm-veined), needles (pines: tufts).
+const LEAVES := {"olive": "lance", "oak": "oval", "carob": "oval", "plane": "broad", "fig": "broad",
+	"aleppo_pine": "needles", "stone_pine": "needles"}
+
+
+## A clump up close: twigs out through it, and along them cards of leaves -
+## sprays of single leaves the shader cuts out (each leaf its own shade), pine
+## needles in crossed tufts; turned every way, facing out of the crown.
+static func _leaf_cloud(m: M, rr: RandomNumberGenerator, c: Vector3, r: Vector3, col: Color, cc: Vector3, cr: Vector3, fleck: float, fleck_col: Color) -> void:
+	var type: int = CARD_OF.get(m.leaf_shape, CARD_OVAL)
+	var twigs := 5
+	var starts: Array = []
+	var ends: Array = []
+	var out0 := ((c - cc) / cr)
+	for k in twigs:
+		var d := (_rdir(rr) + Vector3.UP * 0.3 + out0 * 0.8).normalized()
+		var a := c - d * minf(r.x, r.y) * 0.4
+		var e := c + d * r * 0.7
+		starts.append(a)
+		ends.append(e)
+		_tube(m, rr.randi(), PackedVector3Array([a, e]), PackedFloat32Array([0.035 * minf(r.x, 2.0), 0.012]), 3, m.bark)
+	var size: float = {CARD_LANCE: 0.6, CARD_OVAL: 0.62, CARD_BROAD: 0.4, CARD_NEEDLES: 0.62}[type]
+	var cards := int(clampf(r.x * r.z * 26.0, 20.0, 64.0 if type != CARD_NEEDLES else 40.0))
+	m.leaf = 1.0
+	for s in cards:
+		var k := s % twigs
+		var t := rr.randf_range(0.25, 1.0)
+		var at: Vector3 = (starts[k] as Vector3).lerp(ends[k], t)
+		# (out to the clump's skin, mostly: a full crown, not a ball of twigs)
+		var off := _rdir(rr)
+		at = at.lerp(c + off * r * rr.randf_range(0.55, 1.0), 0.65)
+		var cn := ((at - cc) / cr)
+		var hy := clampf((at.y - (cc.y - cr.y)) / (2.0 * cr.y), 0.0, 1.0)
+		var shade := (0.55 + 0.55 * pow(hy, 0.8)) * (0.72 + 0.32 * minf(cn.length(), 1.0))
+		var lc := col * shade * rr.randf_range(0.88, 1.12)
+		if fleck > 0.0 and rr.randf() < fleck * 0.5:
+			lc = lc.lerp(fleck_col, 0.4)
+		lc.a = 1.0
+		var nrm := cn.normalized().lerp(off, 0.3).lerp(Vector3.UP, 0.25).normalized()
+		var up := ((ends[k] - starts[k]) as Vector3).normalized().lerp(off, 0.6).normalized()
+		up = (up - nrm * up.dot(nrm) * 0.7).normalized()
+		var side := nrm.cross(up).normalized()
+		var l := size * rr.randf_range(0.8, 1.2)
+		var p0 := at - up * l * 0.35
+		m.card(p0, side, up, l, l, nrm, lc, type)
+		if type == CARD_NEEDLES and s % 2 == 0:   # (a tuft: two cards crossed)
+			m.card(p0, (up.cross(side) - nrm * 0.0).normalized(), up, l, l, nrm, lc * 0.92, type)
+	m.leaf = 0.0
+
+
+# --- Trees -----------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+const MAX_CLUMPS := 15
+const TIP_BUDGET := 16    # (a crown's clumps at most: the nearest tips' clumps merged into bigger ones)
+
+
+## Tips merged, nearest first, down to `budget` - each [point, direction, length, weight].
+static func _merge_tips(tips: Array, budget: int) -> Array:
+	var out: Array = []
+	for t in tips:
+		out.append([t[0], t[1], t[2], 1.0])
+	while out.size() > budget:
+		var best := INF
+		var bi := 0
+		var bj := 1
+		for i in out.size():
+			for j in range(i + 1, out.size()):
+				var d: float = (out[i][0] as Vector3).distance_squared_to(out[j][0])
+				if d < best:
+					best = d
+					bi = i
+					bj = j
+		var a: Array = out[bi]
+		var b: Array = out[bj]
+		var w: float = a[3] + b[3]
+		out[bi] = [(a[0] * a[3] + b[0] * b[3]) / w, ((a[1] as Vector3) + (b[1] as Vector3)).normalized(), maxf(a[2], b[2]), w]
+		out.remove_at(bj)
+	return out
+
+const TREE := {

+	"olive": {"h": Vector2(1.2, 2.2), "r": Vector2(0.26, 0.4), "lean": 0.35, "stems": Vector2i(1, 3), "crown": Vector2(0.85, 1.15), "flat": 0.72, "fill": 3,

+			"lobe": 0.22, "twist": 5.0, "taper": 0.6, "segs": 3}, "fleck": 0.22, "fleck_col": Color(0.58, 0.63, 0.55)},

+		"P": {"depth": 2, "kids": Vector2i(3, 4), "spread": 0.8, "rise": 0.2, "wiggle": 0.25, "shrink": 0.7, "len": 5.5, "from": 0.35,
+			"mottle": 0.35, "patch": Color(0.62, 0.6, 0.5), "taper": 0.55, "segs": 3}},

+		"P": {"depth": 2, "kids": Vector2i(3, 4), "spread": 0.85, "rise": 0.25, "wiggle": 0.4, "shrink": 0.68, "len": 3.4, "from": 0.35,

+		"P": {"depth": 2, "kids": Vector2i(3, 4), "spread": 1.0, "rise": 0.1, "wiggle": 0.35, "shrink": 0.66, "len": 2.6, "from": 0.3,

+		"P": {"depth": 2, "kids": Vector2i(2, 3), "spread": 0.8, "rise": 0.18, "wiggle": 0.35, "shrink": 0.7, "len": 2.0, "from": 0.4,

+	"aleppo_pine": {"h": Vector2(4.5, 7.0), "r": Vector2(0.24, 0.34), "lean": 0.22, "stems": Vector2i(1, 1), "crown": Vector2(1.1, 1.5), "flat": 0.55, "fill": 1,
+		"P": {"depth": 2, "kids": Vector2i(3, 5), "spread": 1.05, "rise": 0.12, "wiggle": 0.35, "shrink": 0.62, "len": 3.2, "from": 0.55,
+			"lobe": 0.05, "taper": 0.5, "segs": 3}, "sinuous": 0.35},

+		"P": {"depth": 2, "kids": Vector2i(2, 3), "spread": 0.7, "rise": 0.25, "wiggle": 0.45, "shrink": 0.62, "len": 3.0, "from": 0.4,
+			"lobe": 0.12, "twist": 4.0, "taper": 0.35, "segs": 3}},

+		"P": {"depth": 2, "kids": Vector2i(2, 3), "spread": 0.6, "rise": 0.35, "wiggle": 0.55, "shrink": 0.75, "len": 2.2, "from": 0.5,
